Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's all from this game! Excellent performance from India Women. The multi-format series scoreline is 8-6 now with England Women ahead and India Women need to win the final game to share the series. The third T20I will be played on Wednesday, 14th July 2021 at 1830 local (1730 GMT). Do join us then. Cheers and take care.

Deepti Sharma, the PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says that it was important to get partnerships and the mindset was to get as many runs as possible. Tells that her plan was to bowl as many dot balls as she can and cut the boundaries.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the India skipper, says that it was a great effort by the whole team and she is happy with the win. Adds that they got a very good start with the bat but in the middle, they did not get many runs and that is why she went to give the momentum. Says that the bowlers bowled well and the field placement was very important. Tells that the fielding was outstanding. Goes onto say they always want to win wherever they go and they are getting used to the bubble. Credits the support staff for keeping them motivated and the whole unit is doing really well.

Heather Knight, the England skipper, says that they were very good throughout the game and they got off to a flying start and they are disappointed not to get the win. Adds that her run out was unfortunate and it was not intentional from Deepti Sharma. Adds that losing her and Beaumont put pressure on the lower order. Tells that they have got a strong batting line-up and they should have won this game. Goes onto say that they cannot lose the series but they want to win. Credits India for playing really well.

Now, now, where did England Women lose the game? They were cruising when Tammy Beaumont and Heather Knight were at the crease. They needed around 6 runs per over when Beaumont fell but when Knight too departed in the same over, things changed. Amy Jones hit a few lusty blows but not enough and there was basically nothing from the lower order and they have crashed to a defeat. England will be very disappointed with the effort. Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony...

India Women were off to a good start as they got rid of Danni Wyatt and Natalie Sciver in quick succession but then the wickets dried up and the runs were coming quickly for England but once Deepti Sharma got rid of Tammy Beaumont, things changed. They kept picking up regular wickets courtesy of their slow bowlers who were simply terrific in this game. Sneh Rana was economical, Poonam Yadav was sensational in her spell while Deepti Sharma was the one who changed the game. Overall, an excellent bowling performance.

Excellent win from India Women! They will be really pleased and the multi-tour scoreline now reads England 8, India 6. They cannot win the series but they have a chance to level it now. This is an excellent bowling performance. England Women will be disappointed as they had this game in the bag but they have faltered.
There it is, India Women win by 8 runs. A tossed up ball, on middle. Sarah Glenn sweeps it to mid-wicket for a single.
This might do for India! A full ball, on middle. Sophie Ecclestone works it to long on for a single. 10 runs required off 1 ball.
There is a slight halt in play as Sneh Rana has hurt herself and she needs some treatment.
Ouchh! That might hurt! A loopy ball, on middle. Sophie Ecclestone hammers it straight back to Rana, who gets her hand out and half-stops it. She looks in pain.
LEG BYE! Flatter ball, on middle. Glenn misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls over to the off side.

OUT! RUNOUT! Fuller ball, on leg pole. Sophie Ecclestone flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single. She runs back for the second run but was denied by Ecclestone. Villiers turn back and stretches her arm, but before that, the keeper had clipped the bails off. The third umpire has a timely look on it and decides Villiers was out of her crease.
A run out taken upstairs.
Loopy ball, on middle. Mady Villiers whacks it to mid-wicket for a single. 13 runs required now.
Dot to end the over! Fullish length ball, way outside off. Sophie Ecclestone shuffles across and misses her drive. 14 required off 6.
Tosses it up, on middle. Mady Villiers lofts it just short of long on for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Mady Villiers misses her reverse sweep.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! England Women are 7 down now! A short ball, outside off, skids through the surface. Katherine Brunt waits for the ball to arrive and looks to cut but kisses her outside edge to Richa Ghosh, the keeper, who appeals for caught behind and the umpire raises finger instantly.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Poonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Full ball, way outside off. Left alone. Wided.
In the air and safe! Loopy ball, on off. Sophie Ecclestone lofts it onto the vacant cover region. Single taken.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
DROPPED! Would have been an excellent end to her spell! Bowls a flatter, quicker ball, on off. Sophie Ecclestone hammers it straight towards Sharma who gets her hand out but fails to gobble it up.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to long off for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for one run.
TWO WIDES! Brunt makes room on the off side. Sharma follows her with a quicker ball. Brunt misses her push and the keeper misses to carry it. Single taken.
Tossed up, on off. Eased down to long on for a single.
On off, defended to the off side.
Full on the pads, Brunt looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. A leg bye taken as the ball goes to the leg side.
Sophie Ecclestone is the next batter in.
Flatter on middle. Blocked out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Amy Jones falls into the trap and India Women are right back into this game! Tosses it up, outside off. Amy Jones shuffles across and paddles it straight in the hands of Sneh Rana who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Poonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: On middle. Brunt comes down the track and whips it to mid-wicket for one.
Beautiful delivery! Loopy ball, outside off. Brunt looks to paddle it but misses.
Flights this one, outside off. Jones works it to short third man for one.
Full ball, on off, driven to long off for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Katherine Brunt works it to cover and takes a quick single. 27 needed off 24 balls.
On middle, eased down to mid on for a single.
Katherine Brunt is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Brilliant work from India Women in the field. On middle. Jones flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket. Mandhana in the deep fires in a throw at the bowler's end. The batters look to sneak a couple but the throw is a good one to Sharma who whips the bails off. The third umpire is called for and the replays show that Dunkley was well short of her crease.
Run out appeal has been taken up. Let's see what happens.
A slower flatter ball, on middle. Sophia Dunkley paddles it to fine leg for a single.
Flatter on middle, flicks it to mid-wicket for another single.
Tossed up, on middle. Dunkley paddles it to square leg for one.
Flighted on off, Jones plays it to mid off. 33 needed in 30 balls.
Full on off, pushed to cover.
PLAY AND A MISS! Floated outside off, Jones looks to drive but misses.
Tossed up outside off, Dunkley drives it to deep cover for just a single.
Full outside off, Jones drives it to deep cover for a single. NO BALL. Free Hit to follow.
SIX! Pressure, what pressure! Brilliant shot from Amy Jones! Shortish on the pads, Jones pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Flatter ball outside off, Dunkley punches it to deep cover for a single.
Harleen Deol has been introduced to bowl.
On middle, punched back to the bowler.
Sophia Dunkley walks out to bat now

OUT! RUN OUT! Very unfortunate way to get out for Heather Knight and India are back in the game big time! England will now have two new batters at the crease. Flatter ball on middle, Jones works it to the right of the bowler. Sharma dives and tries to stop it but collides with Knight in the process. The ball seems to have hit the boot of Sharma and then hit the stumps at her end. India appeal and the third umpire is called for. The third umpire wants to check if the ball has made contact with the boot and the replays show that it has and Knight is a goner. Knight is shocked as to what has happened but it is the right decision one feels as Deepti Sharma did not stop her intentionally.
Run out appeal has been taken up. Replay shows Knight was well out of her crease.
Amy Jones walks out to bat.
England review for LBW now. Ball tracker shows Umpire's call.

OUT! LBW! Umpire's call it is and India take a wicket! Is there still life in this game? Tammy Beaumont goes after playing a very good knock. Tossed up on middle, Beaumont dances down and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. India appeal and up goes the finger. Beaumont takes the review. The Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call on hitting.
Flatter on middle, played back to the bowler.
Review has been taken for LBW by India. Ultra edge shows no bat involved. Ball tracker shows umpire's call on impact.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call it is! Floated around off, Beaumont looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. India take the review. The Ultra Edge shows no bat while the Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call on impact.
Flatter on middle, Knight works it to the leg side for one.
Deepti Sharma is back into the attack.
Full toss on middle, heaved to the deep square leg region for two.
Nicely played! Full on middle, Beaumont paddles it to the fine leg region for two more.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! No luck for Reddy! Fullish ball around off, Beaumont looks to sweep but gets a top edge and it goes over the keeper for a boundary. 100 up for England.
Length ball on off, Heather defends it to point for one.
FOUR! Loose delivery from Reddy! Good length ball outside off, Knight cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Full on middle, worked to mid on.
Arundhati Reddy is back into the attack. Her figures till now read 2-0-17-1.
Loopy ball on off, Tammy defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, punched to cover.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Full on the pads, Beaumont uses her feet and looks to flick but mistimes it to short fine leg.
Full on middle, Knight works it to long on for one.
Floated on middle, Beaumont looks to reverse sweep but it goes off her inside edge, hits the pads and goes to the leg side. A single taken.
On off, punched to the off side.
FOUR! Hit hard! No chance for the fielder in the deep! Shorter outside off, Knight punches it to deep cover. Mandhana comes across but fails to stop it. A boundary.
Loopy ball on off, Tammy uses her feet and then plays it wide of mid off for a single. She reaches her fifty as well. Her 9th in this format.
Flatter outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! Tossed up on off, Knight sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up.
Radha Yadav is back into the attack.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, flicked to square leg for one. England Women require 69 off 60 balls.
Loopy ball, on middle. Tammy Beaumont flicks it to mid-wicket. She loses her bat and it falls just around the stumps. Single taken.
WIDE! A shorter ball, way down the leg side. Tammy Beaumont misses her pull. Wided.
Tossed up, on middle. Heather Knight shuffles across and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle, clipped to mid-wicket for one.
On middle. Knight reverse sweeps it to point for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle, stays low a bit. Knight flicks it to short fine leg.
Deepti Sharma is on.

TWO BYES! Another loopy ball, outside off. Tammy Beaumont shuffles again and looks to heave it but misses it. The keeper also misses to grab it and the batters take two byes. 75 runs required in 66 balls.
Around off, kept out watchfully.
FOUR! Well played! Another short ball, on off. Tammy Beaumont shuffles across on the off side and pulls it away to square leg for a boundary.
Around off, pushed to cover for a single.
Outside off. Knight misses her cut.

Good fielding in the deep! A slower short ball, on middle. Tammy Beaumont shuffles across and pulls it over square leg fielder. Sneh Rana from deep mid-wicket runs across, dives and saves a run for her team.
On middle. Reverse sweeps it again but this time off the upper part of her blade towards third man for one.
Flatter on middle. Pushed to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Tammy Beaumont steps down the track and flicks it to short fine leg for a single.
Good running between the wickets! Fullish length, on middle. Tucked away to square leg for two.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Cleverly played! Tossed up ball, outside off. Knight reverse sweeps it past point for a boundary.
Tammy Beaumont shuffles across, Poonam Yadav follows her with a flatter ball, way outside off. Cuts to cover for nothing.
Around off. Driven through covers for a single.
Brilliant delivery! Pitches it up, outside off. Heather Knight looks to paddle sweep it but misses it completly.
Another tossed up ball, outside off. Heather Knight looks to cut but misses.
Tossed up, outside off, spins away. Knight cuts it to cover.
Pitches it up, outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Poonam Yadav is into the attack.
On middle. Tammy Beaumont charges down the track and chips it to long on for one. End of the Powerplay. England are 52 for 2.
50 up for England Women! Short ball, on middle. Tammy Beaumont pulls it to square leg who half-stops it. Couple taken before the ball is thrown back to the keeper.
On middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Loud appeal from India but nothing from the umpire! A flatter ball, just around off. Tammy Beaumont looks to paddle sweep but misses. The keeper collects and appeals for caught behind but not given.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball, on leg pole. Tammy Beaumont sweeps it past short fine leg. The ball didn't had the legs to race away. Two taken.
Sneh Rana is into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, Knight looks to defend but misses.

Catch taken but won't matter. Good length ball around off, Beaumont looks to smack it out of the park but gets a top edge and it goes towards mid-wicket. The catch is taken but does not matter. One run.
Good length ball outside off, Beaumont looks to cut but misses. Beaumont wants to take a bye as Ghosh fumbles but Knight sends her back. No Ball. Free Hit.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed to the off side for one.
Good length ball outside off, driven to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Cut away nicely! Good length ball outside off, Beaumont cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Arundhati Reddy is back into the attack.
Good length ball on off, Knight guides it to third man for one.
Full on middle, Beaumont defends it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched to deep cover for one.
Tossed up on middle, Beaumont lifts it over mid on for one.
NO BALL! This is not working for Radha Yadav! Short outside off, it rolls along the ground, bounces twice before it goes to the keeper. Free Hit.
What was that? Flatter ball on off, it did not bounce at all and almost rolled off the surfacce. Beaumont waits for it and then plays it to cover.
On middle, swept to short fine leg.
FOUR! Bang! Beaumont continues to attack. Floated outside off, Beaumont punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
Full on off, Knight pushes it to mid off.
Radha Yadav comes into the attack.
Heather Knight walks out now.

OUT! RUN OUT! What a piece of fielding from the keeper from Richa Ghosh! She has hit a direct hit and sends back Natalie Sciver. This could be a turning point in the game. Full way outside off, Beaumont lets it go. The keeper fails to collect and the batters look for a run. Ghosh though is quick in running back, and collecting the ball. She has a shy at the keeper's end and hits. Sciver is well short and there is no need of the third umpire as well.
Good length ball around off, Sciver looks to play it on the leg side but gets an inside edge to the leg side for one.
Good length ball on middle, worked to square leg for one.
Full outside off, Beaumont drives it through extra cover and picks up two before the fielder cuts it off.
FOUR! SMACK! Shortish and outside off, Beaumont punches it through cover for a boundary.
FIVE WIDES! Poor stuff from Pandey! Good length ball down the leg side, Beaumont looks to flick but misses. Richa Ghosh misses and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Beaumont! Good length ball outside off, Beaumont cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Who will walk out to bat now? It is Natalie Sciver.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is what India needed! An early wicket in the Powerplay. Danni Wyatt goes for just three. Full on off, Wyatt shuffles across and looks to go over mid off but fails to get the elevation and the timing. Harmanpreet Kaur takes a simple catch at mid off. England Women need 136 in 108 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Arundhati Reddy

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, played to mid on for one.
An appeal for run out has been taken up. The batter was well in her crease.

NOT OUT! Wyatt is in comfortably! Full toss on off, Wyatt plays it to mid off and takes off for a run. The fielder collects, has a shy at the bowler's end and hits. Third umpire is called for and the replays show that Wyatt is in.
Good length ball outside off, Tammy punches it to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Good length ball on middle, Beaumont lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
WIDE! Full ball way outside off, Beaumont lets it go. Wided.
Good length ball outside off, Tammy cuts it to point.
Arundhati Reddy will bowl from the other end.
Good length ball on the pads, Wyatt looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire says no. Good start from Pandey.
On a length on the pads, Beaumont looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
Full on middle, Wyatt looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to the leg side for one.
Full on the pads, Beaumont works it to the leg side for a run.
EDGY! Good length ball around off, Wyatt looks to defend but gets an outside edge and it flies to third man for a single.
England are underway! Full on off, Beaumont defends it to cover for a single.
